Hey — we're launching the Clarity Plus campaign in September and I need you to put together a proper creative brief that our UGC creators and designers can actually use before production starts on August 28th.

Right now we've got a bunch of notes, ingredient info, compliance docs, audience research, and offer details scattered all over the /workspace folder. There's also an old brief in there from a previous campaign that is NOT relevant — please ignore it.

The brief needs to give our creative team real, specific direction — not vague fluff. It should cover the campaign goal, who we're talking to, the actual angle and why it's the right one, specific hooks they can test, the proof points that matter (including our certification), the current offer details (exact code and expiry), and critically, the compliance guardrails — our legal team has been flagging scripts and we can't afford another round of that.

Please save the final brief as `clarity_plus_creative_brief.md` somewhere in the workspace.
